title: Coherence lengths of light sources
caption: Fringes need path differences shorter than the coherence length l_c ≈ λ²/Δλ. For the LED, l_c = (630 nm)²/20 nm ≈ 20 μm; white light manages about 1 μm, a sodium lamp about 1 mm, a HeNe laser 0.1–1 m and stabilised lasers kilometres: 9 orders of magnitude across the range.
alt: A logarithmic scale of coherence length in metres from 10^-7 to 10^4 with white light at about 1 micrometre, an LED at 20 micrometres, a sodium lamp at 1 millimetre, a HeNe laser at tenths of a metre and stabilised lasers at kilometres.
description: A horizontal logarithmic scale of coherence length in metres.
Marked from shortest to longest: white light ~1 μm, the lesson's LED 20 μm, sodium lamp ~1 mm, HeNe laser 0.1–1 m, stabilised laser ~1 km.
The longer the coherence length, the larger the path difference over which clear fringes appear: white light shows fringes only from thin films, lasers from interferometers many metres across.

claims.name: a sodium lamp is about 50 times the LED's coherence length
the sources span 9 orders of magnitude
